---
title: "Hussainiat Ki Fizza Tou Hai Na"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Manqabat"
poet: "Shaukat"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

1
Hussainiat Ki Fizza Tou Hai Na.
Sada Sada Yeh Sada Tou Hai Na.
Zameen Hai Aasman Se Behter.
Keh Oss Pe Farsh-e-Azza Tou Hai Na.

2
Hussain Ke Dar Se Khak Le Lo.
Keh Khak Mein Bhi Shifa Tou Hai Na.
Dua-e-Zahra Baray-e-Momin.
Karm Ki Yeh Inteha Tou Hai Na.

3
Hussain Ka Bhi Parho Na Kalma.
Hussain Bhi Mustafa Tou Hai Na.
Yeh Dil Musalsal Dharak Raha Hai.
Sakhi Ka Matam Bapa Tou Hai Na.

4
Ali Ki Ulfat Baghair-e-Sajda.
Adda Bhi Ho Par Qaza Tou Hai Na.
Janab-e- Shaukat Ka Fun Kahan Hai.
Ali Wali Ki Atta Tou Hai Na.

from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/hussainiat-ki-fizza-tou-hai-na-tajpoints-82a5b6d88f35027548bd.md')
_, header, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = header.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
for edition, numbers in [(roman, '1234'), (body, '۱۲۳۴')]:
    stanzas = edition.strip().split('\\n\\n')
    assert len(stanzas) == 4
    for stanza, number in zip(stanzas, numbers):
        lines = stanza.splitlines()
        assert len(lines) == 5 and lines[0].strip() == number
assert 'noUrdu' not in header and 'direction: \"rtl\"' in header
print('Verified four numbered stanzas of four verses in both editions.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 16 verses in Urdu script and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both versions have four matching stanzas. Updated the title and right-to-left direction, and removed the `noUrdu` tag. Only the selected Markdown file changed.

I read the ambiguous “Sada sada yeh sada” as “سادہ سادہ یہ صدا”.
